reason: The plugin’s primary function is to provide an in-app office content workflow for DeepSeek Harness users: creating, editing, importing, and exporting spreadsheet, document, presentation, and related content, then reviewing changes in conversation. It is exposed through dedicated Univer tools and worktree-based task execution with merge/discard controls, so its user-facing purpose is office document processing via automation rather than general development tooling.

summaries.zh: 该插件将 Univer 办公能力接入 DeepSeek Harness，让智能体按自然语言创建、编辑并导入/导出表格、文档、演示稿和关联内容，并在会话中展示预览与变更确认流程。
summaries.en: This plugin integrates Univer office capabilities into DeepSeek Harness so an agent can create, edit, import, and export spreadsheets, documents, presentations, and related content from natural language requests with in-conversation preview and review.

capabilities: Creates and edits spreadsheet, document, presentation, database, and canvas content via agent-driven tools
Imports and exports common office formats such as XLSX/CSV/TSV, DOCX, and PPTX
Provides isolated worktree-based draft/merge/discard workflow for changes
Runs local gateway/viewer components with optional browser-based render/lint steps

reasons.code: README lists a set of `univer_*` tools (for create/status/worktree/unit import/inspect/execute/export/lint/api) that directly manipulate workspace Office content.
README capability matrix and feature list include direct Sheet/Doc/Slide/Base/Board editing features and format conversion (xlsx/csv/tsv/docx/pptx).
README describes isolated worktree lifecycle with explicit merge/discard and live preview/review, indicating controlled file-change flow.
Package metadata identifies a bundled Gateway/Viewer web plugin package with runtime dependencies including Puppeteer browser tooling, indicating local execution/runtime components.
